### Added

- (agent-platform) [Render files attached to a session's messages](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2459) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — On a session's page, an image attached to a message shows inline and opens at full size when selected. Any other file shows as a chip with its name, type and size.
- (gs) [Read the Installations page's versions in one request](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2721) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — The Installations page reads its `Kubernetes version` and `Release` columns in one request: all rows fill within seconds instead of one by one, and at once from the cache on a revisit.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v2.88.0...v2.89.0
